name: Why does my toilet only flush sometimes?

mainEntity.name: Why does my toilet only flush sometimes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intermittent flushing problems often point to issues with the toilet's internal mechanisms. This could be a flapper that doesn't seal consistently, a fill valve that's failing to refill the tank properly every time, or a loose or misaligned flush handle and chain. Sediment buildup can also intermittently affect components. It's a sign that a component is nearing the end of its lifespan. Alpha-Plumbing Services can diagnose and fix these sporadic issues for residents in our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Intermittent flushing usually indicates a failing flapper, an inconsistent fill valve, or a problem with the flush handle and chain mechanism.
